entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Hi, you're speaking with Charlie at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Finally! I need to return this helmet I bought. This is completely unacceptable, I want my money back now.
I can certainly look into that for you. I'm sorry to hear you're not happy with your purchase. To pull up your account, could I get your order number or the email address you used?
It's VF-8675309. And you'd better be able to help. I'm a VIP member and this whole experience has been a disaster.

Thank you. I'm pulling up the order now... I see the purchase here for the AeroPro helmet. So I can best assist you, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?

The issue is that I hate it! The color is nothing like what you show online. It's hideous. And frankly, after I got it, I started reading things that make me question its safety. I haven't even taken it out of the packaging; the box is unopened, right here.

I understand your frustration with the color not meeting your expectations, and your concern about safety is completely valid. Let me just confirm our policy for you. I see the delivery was 36 days ago.
I don't care what day it was! Are you going to give me my money back or do I need to speak to your manager? I will light up your reviews page, I swear.

That won't be necessary. Our policy for standard items like this helmet allows for returns within 90 days of delivery, so you're well within the timeframe. Since the box is unopened, I have gone ahead and approved a full refund for you.
About time. So what now? You're sending me a label?

Yes, I've just emailed a prepaid return shipping label to you. And for the trouble with the product color and the frustration this has caused, as you're a VIP member, I've also added a $50 store credit to your account for your next purchase with us. We value your business.
Fine. A refund and a $50 credit. That's acceptable. The label better be in my inbox.
It should be there now. Once we receive the returned helmet, we'll process the full refund back to your original payment method. Can I help with anything else today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
